I didn't like it, I don't recommend it. I felt the assistance wasn't complete, the attention from everyone was very poor, and the reception was very slow. When I went in, I noticed a lot of financial interest. My dog ​​underwent surgery and had some complications at home a few days after the stitches were removed. I called to schedule an appointment with the doctor who operated, and the first thing I heard was: a new consultation will be charged.
I took a chance and went to a clinic near Vila Monumento where I was received with more calm, organization, and attention. My dog ​​had an ulcer resulting from medications probably used during surgery because when she entered the veterinary hospital she was fine and had never had any problems with her gastric system. On top of everything, she needed a surgical re-approach because she had a local infection. Even the scar looked nicer and more carefully done. Another thing! The blood tests performed at the clinic came back with conflicting results. I was very worried about the prognoses raised. I took my pet to a laboratory specializing in pets. To my delight, after a battery of tests, the results were excellent, all normal! Today she is doing great, thank God, and I feel much more secure.
I loved the atmosphere and the food was wonderful.
Good morning, excellent work you do, I loved it! 😉♥️♥️ …
